name: agent-pair
description: Durable cross-provider messaging between two agent sessions, across machines and containers.

interface.shortDescription: Pair a Codex session with a Claude session.
interface.longDescription: A direct TLS-pinned mailbox for two coding agents that survives a peer restart and crosses machine and container boundaries, with durable delivery states, a claim-and-finish inbox, and monitoring. For two Claude Code sessions on one machine, Claude Code's own cross-session messaging is the lighter path.
defaultPrompt: Pair this agent with a peer.
Send a handoff to my paired agent.
